title: Model-based quality control of Argo salinity and oxygen: detecting persistent sensor errors that pass real-time tests: code, models and results

description: Code, trained deep ensembles and result tables for model-based quality control of Argo salinity and dissolved oxygen. Ensembles predicting oxygen and salinity from the physical state, position and season are trained on Indian Ocean Argo floats; their standardized residuals are scored per level, per profile and over each float's life, with thresholds calibrated out of sample. The repository benchmarks the method against a reimplementation of the Argo real-time tests on planted errors and on documented real sensor failures.
notes: Argo data were collected and made freely available by the International Argo Program and the national programs that contribute to it (https://argo.ucsd.edu, https://www.ocean-ops.org). The Argo Program is part of the Global Ocean Observing System.
